title: High Rise Building Facade
description: A seamless fusion of architecture and nature.
image_alt: High rise building facade with layered planting and glazed balconies
meta_title: High Rise Building Facade | Archilance LLC
meta_description: High-rise mixed-use facade design from concept to design development, modelled in Revit and visualised in D5 Render for a seamless architecture-and-nature aesthetic.
summary: A seamless fusion of architecture and nature.
body:
A seamless fusion of architecture and nature.

The brief here was a design one: work the massing and the elevations until the building reads the way it should from the street, then take it far enough that the drawings can be built on.

Everything sits in one coordinated model, so a change to a plan updates the elevations and the render with it. That is the point of working this way — no drift between what was agreed and what gets issued.

title: Construction Permit Set
description: Comprehensive, precise documentation ensuring smooth and efficient permit approval.
image_alt: Construction permit set floor plan with dimensions and window schedule
meta_description: Comprehensive, precise documentation ensuring smooth and efficient permit approval.
summary: Comprehensive, precise documentation ensuring smooth and efficient permit approval.
body:
Comprehensive, precise documentation ensuring smooth and efficient permit approval.

A permit set has one job: get through review without a round of comments. This one was formatted to the authority's requirements from the start rather than converted at the end.

Every sheet is checked against the code notes and the dimensions before issue, and the set goes out with the native files alongside the PDFs.
deliverables: Full drawing set to authority format
